pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which little word goes with the noun "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. den
   D. die

2. Which greeting is correctly written and punctuated? (1 mark)
   A. guten morgen amina
   B. Guten Morgen, Amina!
   C. Gutten Morgen, Amina!
   D. Guten morgen amina.

3. Which little word goes with the noun "Käse"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

4. How many fingers do we have on two hands? (1 mark)
   A. sechs
   B. acht
   C. zehn
   D. zwölf

5. What does "die Eltern" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. family
   B. parents
   C. friend
   D. daughter

6. What is the plural of "der Tisch"? (1 mark)
   A. die Tischer
   B. die Tische
   C. die Tischen
   D. die Tischs

7. Which little word goes with the noun "Tisch"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

8. What does "das Brot" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. onion
   B. bread
   C. cheese
   D. carrot

9. What does "der Fisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. orange
   B. fish
   C. tea
   D. mango

10. What does "Wo spielt das Kind?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What does the child play?
   B. Where does the child play?
   C. Who plays with the child?
   D. When does the child play?

11. Which German word is the number 8? (1 mark)
   A. dreizehn
   B. vierzehn
   C. acht
   D. fünf

12. What does "Nein" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good morning
   B. very good
   C. please
   D. no

13. Which German word means "dry"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. wolkig
   B. trocken
   C. warm
   D. heiß

14. What does "die Wassermelone" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. egg
   C. carrot
   D. banana

15. How is the letter L named in German? (1 mark)
   A. tsay
   B. bay
   C. eff
   D. ell

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write two German sentences about what you would like to do on your birthday. (2 marks)

17. Explain why "Meine Mutter sind nett" is wrong and correct it. (2 marks)

18. Write the German words with der or die for: father, mother, brother, sister. (4 marks)

19. Write the German words with der, die or das for: radio, nose, family. (3 marks)

20. Read and translate: "Wo ist der Ball? Er ist im Garten." (2 marks)

21. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandmother, clock. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — das
   It is das Wasser, so the little word is das.

2. B — Guten Morgen, Amina!
   Capital letters for the first word, the noun and the name, and a mark at the end.

3. C — der
   It is der Käse, so the little word is der.

4. C — zehn
   zehn is ten.

5. B — parents
   die Eltern means parents.

6. B — die Tische
   The plural of der Tisch is die Tische.

7. C — der
   It is der Tisch, so the little word is der.

8. B — bread
   das Brot means bread.

9. B — fish
   der Fisch means fish.

10. B — Where does the child play?
   wo means where.

11. C — acht
   8 in German is acht.

12. D — no
   Nein means no.

13. B — trocken
   dry in German is trocken.

14. A — watermelon
   die Wassermelone means watermelon.

15. D — ell
   In German the letter L is called ell.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich möchte tanzen. Ich möchte Kuchen essen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: With one person we use ist. Correct: Meine Mutter ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason and 1 mark for the correction.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Vater, die Mutter, der Bruder, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each noun with the correct article.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Radio, die Nase, die Familie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Where is the ball? It is in the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Oma, die Uhr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
